description: Backend: the universal short_links subsystem in api-node. Adds the short_links table (no-migrate idempotent raw SQL + Prisma ShortLink model + manual prisma/short-links.sql), a short-link service (base62 code gen, idempotent product auto-create, custom-url create), auto-create wired into single product create (routes/admin.ts) AND bulk import (services/dataImport.ts importProducts), the GET /api/link/:code redirect route (crawler branch reuses services/ogShare.ts buildProductShareHtml; human branch returns a smart-redirect HTML page: Android app via existing App Link/fourastore scheme with ~1.2s Play Store fallback, desktop straight to the website), admin API routes (GET/POST /api/admin/links gated requireStaff('ads')), a public GET /api/products/:id/short-link resolver for the web Share button, and the /link reverse-proxy rule in deploy/4astore-og.conf so /link reaches Node for crawlers AND humans. This FEAT is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 (the web UI consumes these APIs).
steps: ENV FIRST: in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\smart-shortlink\4astore-v2\api-node run `npm install`, then `npx prisma generate`. If the engine download is blocked, copy `c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\api-node\node_modules\.prisma` and `...\node_modules\@prisma\client` from the MAIN checkout into the worktree api-node node_modules (identical schema) and record the TLS-copy fallback in this FEAT's findings.

DB table: add `ensureShortLinkTables()` to api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts following ensureNotificationTables()/ensureMarketingTables() exactly — idempotent `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS short_links (id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, target_url VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, product_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL, created_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, clicks INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uq_short_links_code (code), INDEX idx_short_links_product (product_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci` via prisma.$executeRawUnsafe.

Prisma model: add a `ShortLink` model to api-node/prisma/schema.prisma mirroring the SQL, with `@@map("short_links")`, `code String @unique @db.VarChar(16)`, `@@index([product_id], map: "idx_short_links_product")`, BigInt @id autoincrement UnsignedBigInt, matching column db types.
Manual SQL: add api-node/prisma/short-links.sql in the catalog-version.sql style (header comment + run-once note + the CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS). NO prisma migrate/db push.

Wire startup: in api-node/src/server.ts, inside app.listen(...), add `ensureShortLinkTables().catch((e)=>console.error('[seed] short link tables failed', e));` beside the existing ensureMarketingTables() call; import it from ./services/dataImport.

Service: create api-node/src/services/shortLink.ts exporting generateCode() (base62 6-8 chars via crypto.randomBytes), createShortLinkForProduct(productId:number) (idempotent: return existing row where product_id matches else INSERT with retry on UNIQUE collision, target_url `/product/<id>`, type 'product'; best-effort, never throw), and createCustomShortLink({targetUrl,type,code?,createdBy?}) (normalise target, optional custom code with uniqueness check, auto-generate when absent). Use the prisma.shortLink delegate.

Auto-create single: in api-node/src/routes/admin.ts POST /products `action==='add'` branch, after `prisma.product.create(...)` and `bumpCatalogVersion()`, add `void createShortLinkForProduct(Number(product.id)).catch(()=>undefined);` (fire-and-forget, mirror the runProductSeo pattern; must not block/slow the save).

Auto-create bulk: in api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts importProducts(), after each `prisma.product.upsert(...)`, best-effort `await createShortLinkForProduct(Number(p.id)).catch(()=>undefined)` so bulk import also gets idempotent links.

Redirect route: create api-node/src/routes/link.ts exporting a Router with GET /:code — look up code; friendly 404 HTML if missing; best-effort `UPDATE short_links SET clicks = clicks + 1 WHERE code = ?`; if isCrawler(req.get('user-agent')) (import from ../middleware/ogCrawler) and row.type==='product' with product_id, return buildProductShareHtml(String(product_id)).html (fall back to buildPageShareHtml/buildCategoryShareHtml by type; on notFound fall through to the smart-redirect page); else return the smart-redirect HTML. Set Content-Type text/html; charset=utf-8 and Vary: User-Agent.

Smart-redirect HTML helper (in routes/link.ts): compute target `${SITE_ORIGIN}${targetPath}` (SITE_ORIGIN from ../seo/origin). For a product, targetPath `/product/<id>` is an autoVerify App Link. Page JS: on Android (`/Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent)`) attempt the app (`window.location.href = 'intent://'+host+path+'#Intent;scheme=https;package=com.store4a.app;end'` and/or `fourastore://` scheme) then `setTimeout(()=>location.replace('https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.store4a.app'),1200)`; otherwise `location.replace(target)`. Include `<noscript>` and `<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=TARGET">` to the website target. Escape all interpolated values (reuse escapeHtml from ../services/ogShare).
Mount redirect: in api-node/src/server.ts add `app.use('/api/link', linkRouter);` before the 404 handler (import linkRouter from ./routes/link).

Admin API: create api-node/src/routes/admin-links.ts — `const router = Router(); router.use(requireAuth, requireStaff('ads'));` then GET / (list newest-first with a limit: code,target_url,type,clicks,created_at) and POST / (createCustomShortLink; 409 on duplicate code). Mount in server.ts as `app.use('/api/admin/links', adminLinksRouter);` among the specific /api/admin/* mounts BEFORE the generic `app.use('/api/admin', adminRouter)`.

Public resolver: in api-node/src/routes/catalog.ts add public `GET /products/:id/short-link` returning `{ code }` — creating the link on demand via createShortLinkForProduct if absent, `{ code: null }` only on genuine failure.

Apache include: in 4astore-v2/deploy/4astore-og.conf, inside the existing <IfModule mod_rewrite.c> block, add an ALL-user-agent rule (NOT crawler-UA-gated): `RewriteRule ^/?link/([A-Za-z0-9]+)/?$ http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/link/$1 [P,L]` with a comment that it mirrors the Node /api/link mount and must stay in sync. deploy.sh step 5b already installs this file into Apache conf.d every deploy — confirm by reading step 5b; no deploy.sh edit is needed.
acceptance_criteria: `npx prisma validate` passes in api-node (note TLS-copy fallback if the client was copied from main).
`npm run build` passes in api-node with the new ShortLink model, service, routes, and server mounts.
short_links is created by ensureShortLinkTables() (idempotent) and wired at startup in server.ts beside the other ensure* calls (confirmed by reading server.ts, not grep).

Single product create (routes/admin.ts action 'add') and bulk importProducts() both call createShortLinkForProduct idempotently and fire-and-forget / best-effort so a link failure never blocks the create.

GET /api/link/:code exists: crawler UA returns OG HTML built from services/ogShare.ts (no forked OG logic); human UA returns smart-redirect HTML with Android app attempt + Play Store fallback (com.store4a.app) + <noscript>/<meta refresh> to the website target; missing code returns a friendly 404.
GET/POST /api/admin/links are gated requireAuth+requireStaff('ads') and mounted before the generic /api/admin router; POST creates a link for ANY url and 409s on duplicate custom code.
GET /api/products/:id/short-link returns a usable { code } (created on demand).
deploy/4astore-og.conf has a well-formed all-UA /link reverse-proxy rule inside the mod_rewrite block.
verification: cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\smart-shortlink\4astore-v2\api-node && npm install (if not already) && npx prisma generate (or TLS-copy fallback) && npx prisma validate
cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\smart-shortlink\4astore-v2\api-node && npm run build  (must compile with zero errors)

Read api-node/src/server.ts and confirm ensureShortLinkTables() runs at startup and both app.use('/api/link',...) and app.use('/api/admin/links',...) are mounted (admin-links before the generic /api/admin).

Record (post-deploy, cannot run in worktree): curl -A 'WhatsApp/2.0' https://4astore.com/link/<code> | grep og:image shows the product image; curl -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://4astore.com/link/<code> returns the smart-redirect HTML.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED. `npx prisma validate` → 'The schema at prisma\schema.prisma is valid'. `npm run build` (tsc) → exit 0, zero errors.

PRISMA ENGINE / TLS FALLBACK (important for later steps): `npm install` succeeded, but `npx prisma generate` AND `npx prisma validate` FAIL in this environment with HTTP 403 Forbidden fetching engines from binaries.prisma.sh (download blocked) — this affects the MAIN checkout too, not just the worktree. The MAIN checkout's generated client did NOT yet contain the ShortLink delegate, so copying it would have left `prisma.shortLink` undefined and broken the build. Instead I copied the Prisma 5.22.0 engine BINARIES from the sibling worktree c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\og-eye-bulkpush-flags-cms-polish\4astore-v2\api-node\node_modules (schema-engine-windows.exe + query_engine-windows.dll.node) into this worktree's node_modules\@prisma\engines and node_modules\prisma, then ran generate/validate OFFLINE with env vars PRISMA_SCHEMA_ENGINE_BINARY / PRISMA_QUERY_ENGINE_LIBRARY pointed at them (PRISMA_CLI_QUERY_ENGINE_TYPE=library). This regenerated node_modules/.prisma/client WITH the ShortLink delegate. ACTION FOR MERGE/DEPLOY: after merging to main, run `npx prisma generate` on a box with engine access (or reuse this offline-engine trick) so the main checkout's client gains `prisma.shortLink`; deploy.sh already runs prisma generate.

CODE COLUMN: `code VARCHAR(16)` UNIQUE (uq_short_links_code). Generated codes are base62, default 7 chars (generateCode clamps 6–8). target_url VARCHAR(1000). product_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL, INDEX idx_short_links_product. type VARCHAR(16): 'product' for auto-created product links, 'custom' default for admin links.

PUBLIC RESOLVER PATH (for FEAT-002 web Share button): GET /api/products/:id/short-link → { code } (string, minted on demand; null only on genuine failure). It is a catalogRouter route (mounted at /api, defined right after GET /api/products/:id).

REDIRECT ROUTE: GET /api/link/:code (routes/link.ts) — crawler UA → buildProductShareHtml/page/category from services/ogShare.ts (OG logic NOT forked); human UA → smart-redirect HTML (Android intent:// to package com.store4a.app with 1.2s Play Store fallback + <noscript>/<meta refresh> to the website). Missing/invalid code → friendly 404 HTML. Sets Vary: User-Agent.

ADMIN API: GET/POST /api/admin/links (routes/admin-links.ts) gated requireAuth+requireStaff('ads'), mounted BEFORE generic /api/admin in server.ts. POST creates a link for ANY url; duplicate custom code → 409 (ShortCodeTakenError).

STARTUP: ensureShortLinkTables() wired in server.ts inside app.listen beside ensureMarketingTables(). APACHE: all-UA rule `RewriteRule ^/?link/([A-Za-z0-9]+)/?$ http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/link/$1 [P,L]` added inside the mod_rewrite block of deploy/4astore-og.conf (deploy.sh step 5b installs this file every deploy — no deploy.sh change needed).

NOTE: the copied @prisma/engines binaries + regenerated node_modules/.prisma are gitignored (node_modules not committed), so they are NOT part of the commit — they only make local verification pass.
